clue.text: Right usurps Left in Black Death city

indicators.note: to usurp is to seize another's place, so one letter ousts another from its spot in the word

parts.note: the Black Death was the great plague of the fourteenth century

explanation.surface: A political tale: the Right seizes power from the Left in a city ravaged by plague.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Right usurps Left' tells you to swap the L in PLAGUE for an R.
explanation.definitionFit: Prague is the capital of the Czech Republic, a city by any measure.

clue.text: Lost daughter partied wildly

indicators.note: doing something wildly suggests disorder, so the letters of the next word are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A father laments a daughter gone astray after a night of riotous partying.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakespeare's heroine in The Winter's Tale is named from the Latin for 'lost', having been abandoned as a baby.
explanation.definitionFit: Perdita is the king's abandoned daughter in The Winter's Tale, her name meaning the lost one.

clue.text: Bill receives armed conflict prize

indicators.note: receiving something means taking it in, so one piece holds the other inside it

parts.note: a bill or poster is an advertisement, shortened to ad
armed conflict between nations is war

explanation.surface: Someone named Bill is handed a prize connected with a war.
explanation.definitionFit: A prize and an award are synonyms: both are honours given for merit.

clue.text: Jane edges away after relative becomes leprous

indicators.note: the piece from Jane comes after the relative in the answer

parts.note: an uncle is a family relative

indicators.note: with its edges taken away, only the inner letters of the name remain

explanation.surface: Jane edges nervously away once a relative is found to have leprosy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Edges away' looks like Jane retreating, but it strips the first and last letters from JANE, leaving AN.
explanation.definitionFit: Leprosy was traditionally treated as ritual impurity, so a leprous person was declared unclean.

clue.text: See 15
Say M1 means to supply blood

definitions.meaning: the M1 is a British motorway, an example of a main road or arterial route
a vessel carrying blood from the heart around the body

explanation.surface: A wry remark that the M1 motorway is the nation's lifeline for blood supplies.
explanation.walkthrough: The M1 is the motorway from London to Leeds; a major road is an arterial route.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a major trunk road and a blood vessel leading from the heart.

clue.text: Healer Earth's Lib misrepresented

indicators.note: something misrepresented is distorted, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A healer has been misrepresented by the Earth Liberation movement.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram ignores the apostrophe: EARTHSLIB rearranges into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A herbalist treats illness with plant remedies, so is a kind of healer.

clue.text: Like some bird, marsupial is trapped by King Henry

parts.note: roo is short for kangaroo, a marsupial

indicators.note: something trapped is held inside, so the word is is enclosed by the royal letters

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king
H is the abbreviation for henry, the unit of inductance

explanation.surface: A kangaroo is caught by King Henry, behaving like a bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'King Henry' is two pieces, K and H, which go around IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Rookish means resembling a rook, a member of the crow family.

clue.text: Just not sitting here, cougar took and ran off

indicators.note: off means gone wrong or out of place, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A cougar grabbed something and ran off, while nothing fair was going on here.
explanation.walkthrough: 'And' only links the two runs of fodder; COUGARTOOK plus RAN is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A kangaroo court is an unofficial tribunal that ignores justice, so its sitting is not a fair one.

clue.text: Song from Frau von Trapp millions dismissed

indicators.note: something dismissed is sent away, so that letter is removed

parts.note: Maria von Trapp is the heroine of The Sound of Music
M is the abbreviation for million

explanation.surface: A song from The Sound of Music, the one millions dismissed.
explanation.definitionFit: An aria is a solo song, especially in opera.

clue.text: Talk to knight and pseudo-medievalist poet

parts.note: to chatter is to talk idly
N is the chess notation for knight

explanation.surface: An invitation to chat with a knight and a poet obsessed with the Middle Ages.
explanation.walkthrough: Thomas Chatterton passed off his own verse as the work of a fifteenth-century monk, Thomas Rowley.
explanation.definitionFit: Chatterton was an eighteenth-century poet who forged mock-medieval verse.

clue.text: Theologian in distance comes to centre

indicators.note: one piece sits within the other

parts.note: a mile is a distance
DD, Doctor of Divinity, is a theologian's degree

explanation.surface: A theologian travels a long way to reach a central place.
explanation.definitionFit: The middle and the centre are synonyms for the point equidistant from the edges.

clue.text: Fled, escaping ranger wild as Hilderic?

indicators.note: one word escaping another leaves it, so those letters are taken out

parts.note: fled means ran
manic means wild or frenzied

explanation.surface: A wild ranger flees, as mad as some barbarian king.
explanation.walkthrough: Hilderic was a sixth-century king of the Vandals, a Germanic people; the question mark marks him as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Hilderic ruled the Vandals, one of the Germanic tribes, so he is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Appearance of Fish calling for Chips?

parts.note: a carp is a freshwater fish
an entry is an appearance, as on stage

explanation.surface: The arrival of fish at the chippy calls for chips.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fish' and 'Chips' look like supper; 'Chips' is the traditional British nickname for a carpenter, and 'calling' means vocation.
explanation.definitionFit: Woodworking is the trade or vocation of the person nicknamed Chips.

clue.text: Composer ordered pork, duck and five nuts

indicators.note: put in a fresh order, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: a duck in cricket is a score of nothing, shaped like the letter O

indicators.note: nuts means crazy, so the following letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A composer at a restaurant orders pork, duck and five types of nut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ordered' turns PORK into PROK and 'nuts' turns FIVE into FIEV.
explanation.definitionFit: Sergei Prokofiev was a Russian composer of Peter and the Wolf.

clue.text: Good-looker was female's help in kitchen

parts.note: an attractive person is informally called a dish
her is the female possessive

explanation.surface: An attractive woman once worked as a kitchen hand.
explanation.definitionFit: A machine that cleans plates and cutlery is a labour-saving aid in the kitchen.

clue.text: Game Anfield side delivered?

indicators.note: read as de-livered, the organ is taken away

parts.note: Anfield is the home ground of Liverpool football club

explanation.surface: A football query: was the game the Anfield club played delivered?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Delivered' read as 'de-livered' removes LIVER from LIVERPOOL, whose ground is Anfield.
explanation.definitionFit: Pool is a cue game played on a table with pockets.

clue.text: Parking on corner — it's allowed to clergy

parts.note: re means on or concerning
a bend is a corner in a road

explanation.surface: Parking on a corner is permitted for clergymen.
explanation.definitionFit: A prebend is the stipend a cathedral pays to a canon, an allowance granted to clergy.

clue.text: See 23
Problem solver runs with force inside to cause trouble

indicators.note: these letters go inside the other piece

parts.note: to mix it is to stir up trouble or fight
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: A troubleshooter runs about, using force to stir up bother.
explanation.definitionFit: A Mr Fixit is a handy person who can sort out any problem.

clue.text: Two editors to retain provided one's improved mind

indicators.note: to retain is to hold within, so the pair of editors enclose the middle letters
two calls for the abbreviation twice

parts.note: ED is short for editor
if means provided that
one gives I, the 's being 'has' as a link

explanation.surface: Two editors keep a contributor on condition that their mind is improved.
explanation.definitionFit: To be edified is to be instructed, with one's mind improved morally or intellectually.

clue.text: In the form of money: £51?

parts.note: fifty-one is LI in Roman numerals, and a quid is British slang for a pound sterling

explanation.surface: A query whether fifty-one pounds counts as being in cash.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the sum as 51 = LI, then £ = QUID, the British slang word for a pound.
explanation.definitionFit: Liquid assets are held as cash or readily converted to cash.

clue.text: Big Chief Iron Cuckoo in Stonehenge?

indicators.note: the jumbled metal goes within the monument's letters

parts.note: split as stone plus henge: a stone is a gem, and a henge is a ring, the shape O

indicators.note: cuckoo means crazy, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: A tribal leader in an iron headdress acts crazy at Stonehenge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stonehenge' must be split in two: stone gives GEM and a henge, being a ring of stones, gives the round letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: Geronimo was a famous Apache leader, a chief of his people.

clue.text: Hreidmar's son makes audible fuss close by

indicators.note: audible tells us the word is as heard spoken, not as written

parts.note: faff means fuss and near means close by

explanation.surface: Someone's son is loudly fussing nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: Faff is British slang for fuss; FAFF NEAR said quickly gives the dragon's name.
explanation.definitionFit: In Norse myth Fafnir, who turned into a dragon, was a son of the dwarf king Hreidmar.

clue.text: Hag with deformity, or disfigured benefactor?

indicators.note: disfiguring something spoils its shape, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An ugly old crone, deformed and disfigured, turns out to be a kindly patron.
explanation.walkthrough: 'With' only links; the anagram uses HAG, DEFORMITY and OR, fourteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: In fairy tales such a figure grants wishes and acts as Cinderella's generous protector.

clue.text: Reference work and super novel in 9 brings tragedy

parts.note: the OED, the Oxford English Dictionary, is a reference work

indicators.note: the shuffled letters are placed within the numeral

parts.note: nine is IX in Roman numerals

indicators.note: novel means new, so the letters take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A dictionary and a superb novel together make a tragedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Novel' looks like a book beside the dictionary, but it is the anagram signal; '9' is a Roman numeral.
explanation.definitionFit: Oedipus Rex is the Greek tragedy by Sophocles.

clue.text: Daesh takes two lives

indicators.note: two calls for the word twice

parts.note: lives means is, as in exists

explanation.surface: A terrorist group claims two lives.
explanation.definitionFit: Daesh is the Arabic-derived name for the Islamic State group.

clue.text: Daughter one to see in Rome or Split

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
vide is Latin for see

explanation.surface: A daughter must choose whether to see Rome or the Croatian city of Split.
explanation.walkthrough: Split looks like the Croatian city alongside Rome, but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To divide is to separate into parts, the same as to split.

clue.text: Restrained always in disease of love

indicators.note: one piece goes within the other

parts.note: an STD is a sexually transmitted disease
aye is an old word meaning always

explanation.surface: Someone held back, forever trapped in lovesickness.
explanation.definitionFit: Stayed in the sense of checked or held back, as in staying an execution.
